## 主张 Claim

在共同纤维紧致、表示准确且约简时，整体代码的共同分解可从该整体的任一给定原生代表提升。 / Under joint-fiber compactness and an exact reduced presentation, a code-level joint decomposition lifts from any given native representative of the whole code.

- 2026-10-14，整合 I3（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述，附加一个假设。新的核心模块 Becoming.Composition（只导入 Becoming.Likeness）加入一配置把两配置作为部分共同持有的关系（JointFrame），以及联合检验、联合相同、紧致、嵌套计划与足迹；Becoming.CompositionBridge 把 ExplanatoryJointness 与 ExplanatoryFootprints 读作实例。描述提升其所读之部分，恰当其所认同的配置把部分匹配到其所认同的配置（liftsFromEach_iff；外围只有一个充分方向）；若描述恰认同通过相同联合检验的配置，部分对紧致且检验稳定，则提升之（liftsFromEach_of_sameJointTests）。精确约化表示恰认同这些配置，codeJoint 即核心的 jointImage，所以在模型检验稳定处 code_joint_lifts_from_whole 在脊柱上成立（code_joint_lifts_from_whole_of_stable）；排中律给出稳定，无稳定时外围以经典方式所走的一步恰是排中律（matchesParts_of_compact_iff_em）。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围；有限纤维无排中律是否紧致仍开放。 / 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine, with one added hypothesis. The new core module Becoming.Composition, importing only Becoming.Likeness, adds the relation by which a configuration holds two configurations together as its parts (JointFrame), with joint tests, joint likeness, compactness, nested plans and footprints; Becoming.CompositionBridge reads ExplanatoryJointness and ExplanatoryFootprints as instances. A description lifts the parts it reads exactly where configurations it identifies match parts into configurations it identifies (liftsFromEach_iff; the periphery had one sufficient direction), and where it identifies exactly the configurations passing the same joint tests, the pairs of parts being compact and the tests stable, it lifts them (liftsFromEach_of_sameJointTests). An exact reduced presentation identifies exactly those configurations, and codeJoint is the core's jointImage, so code_joint_lifts_from_whole holds on the spine where the model's tests are stable (code_joint_lifts_from_whole_of_stable); excluded middle gives stability, and without stability the step the periphery takes classically is exactly excluded middle (matchesParts_of_compact_iff_em). Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope; whether finite fibres are compact without excluded middle is open.
